info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Airline Flights Upgrade-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Upgrade API enables users to enhance their existing flight reservations by upgrading to a higher class. This service is designed for customers looking to improve their travel experience, allowing them to access more comfortable seating and exclusive amenities. Typically utilized by frequent flyers and travel agencies, this API streamlines the upgrade process for flights. It supports operations for modifying the booking status of flights, ensuring that users can swiftly and efficiently manage their travel preferences.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to upgrade their existing flight bookings to a higher class or service level. A successful upgrade may depend on availability and fare differences.
